decisions: Amended minutes of the June 25, 2025 meeting approved unanimously.
Reallocation of $150,000 from contingency reserve approved; Aiyana Park to submit infrastructure upgrade plan by August 8, 2025.
Margaret Holvan to contact Polestar Industries COO by July 28, 2025, to address outstanding payments of $118,000.
If Polestar Industries outstanding balance not settled by August 15, 2025, Pierre Dubois authorized to issue formal payment default notice.
Legal counsel to be engaged by July 30, 2025, to draft contract amendments for Polestar Industries covering change-order billing and scope limitation.
Aiyana Park to prepare revised Polestar Industries service delivery schedule reflecting original contracted scope only.
Nexbridge Talent and Crestfield Executive Search engaged for H2 2025 recruitment; agency agreements to be signed by August 1, 2025.
Employee referral incentive program approved at $2,500 per successful hire, effective August 1, 2025.
H2 2025 hiring cap set at 7 new full-time employees, with October 2025 review.
Margaret Holvan to lead Q3 business development targeting Farrow Dynamics and Kelso Group.
Updated service portfolio to be finalized and published by September 1, 2025.
Aiyana Park to deliver Vancouver regional office feasibility report by September 15, 2025.
Pierre Dubois authorized to retain cybersecurity firm (budget ceiling $40,000) to remediate audit findings by October 23, 2025.
External legal counsel to deliver contractor classification compliance action plan by September 30, 2025.
Board mandates Q3–Q4 2025 business development to prioritize client portfolio diversification to address concentration risk.
